description:
Outcome: Coordinator prepares trusted seasonal allocation data, from brief.md: Background and Rules
Scope: 40 uniquely labelled plots; household/email memberships; coordinator bootstrap; validated prior-season holdings import with preview; exact March-October season dates, timezone, February cutoff and digest schedule; audited duplicate-household merge before allocation. Excludes: Public contact directory
Acceptance: Exactly 40 unique plots; conflicting household/email records require resolution; unique household and plot holdings per season enforced in database; initial roster and required seasonal configuration approved by coordinator before opening
Behaviour: Accessible forms and invalid-row explanations; atomic import/merge with no partial corruption
Verification: Constraint, invalid import, merge, access-control and timezone-boundary tests. Prerequisites: T-001. Assumptions: Coordinator is final authority on household identity; synthetic data in development
title: Household, season and plot records
